**[[Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria (2023–present)|Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria]]

****Three [[United States Army|American soldiers]] are killed and 47 others are injured in a [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] upon a [[United States|U.S.]] base in [[Rukban]], [[Mafraq Governorate]], [[Jordan]], near the [[Jordan–Syria border|border]] with [[Syria]], by [[Islamic Resistance in Iraq (2020–present)|Islamic Resistance in Iraq]] [[militant]]s. **[[2024 Istanbul church shooting]]
***A Turkish man is shot dead by two masked gunmen at an [[Italy|Italian]] [[Roman Catholic]] [[church (building)|church]] in [[Sarıyer]], [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. The [[Islamic State]] claims responsibility. [https://apnews.com/article/istanbul-church-attack-islamic-state-18ba89071eb86cd455554cd20187d190 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Twenty-two people are killed during a [[mass shooting]] at the village of Motogatta in the [[Tillabéri Region]], in [[Niger]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/22-civilians-killed-in-attack-on-village-in-western-niger-local-sources-8d2de9b4 (Barron's)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*In [[Afghanistan]], ten [[traffic collision|vehicles crash]] on the main highway linking [[Kabul]] and the eastern [[Nangarhar Province]], killing 17 people and wounding ten others. Separately, 15 people are killed during four collisions in [[Laghman Province]], near the end of the same highway. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-traffic-crashes-16912fefc88607f5687127ba64abb2b5 (AP)]
*A [[Piper PA-46]] [[aviation accidents and incidents|crashes]] in the [[rural area]] of [[Itapeva, Minas Gerais|Itapeva]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]], killing all seven people on board. [https://oglobo.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2024/01/28/tragedia-descreve-testemunha-sobre-queda-de-aviao-monomotor-que-matou-5-pessoas-no-sul-de-minas.ghtml (O Globo)]
*Six hundred [[hectare]]s of forest are destroyed by fire in [[Los Alerces National Park]], a [[UNESCO]] [[World Heritage Site]] in [[Patagonia]], [[Argentina]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2506558-honderden-hectare-aan-unesco-erfgoed-in-vlammen-opgegaan-in-argentinie (NOS)]
*A local official in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of Congo]], reports that an overloaded wooden boat, on board 50 people, has capsized on [[Lake Kivu]] on Sunday. Three people died, while [[search and rescue|search]] is ongoing for about 37 others. [https://www.africanews.com/2024/01/30/dozens-are-presumed-dead-after-an-overloaded-boat-capsizes-on-lake-kivu-in-congo/ (AP via Africanews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Environmental movement|Environmental protesters]] throw [[pumpkin soup]] at the ''[[Mona Lisa]]'' in the [[Louvre]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. The painting is protected by [[bulletproof glass]] and was not damaged. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68121654 (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 ATP Tour]]
**[[2024 Australian Open]]
***In [[tennis]], [[Jannik Sinner]] defeats [[Daniil Medvedev]] in [[2024 Australian Open – Men's singles final|the final]], 3–6, 3–6, 6–4, 6–4, 6–3, to win [[2024 Australian Open – Men's singles|the men's singles title]] at the 2024 [[Australian Open]]. It is Sinner's first [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|major]] singles title and the first for an [[Tennis in Italy|Italian]] player at the tournament. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/01/28/sport/jannik-sinner-daniil-medvedev-2024-australian-open-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
